ha_attributes.whats_new:
Analyzer Framework Version  6.26.4 includes

Main fix is Home page analyzer Tiles not working in Chrome and Edge now work as expected.

Analyzer Framework Version 6.26.3
- Fixes an error in the Patch Wizard analyzer when there are no previous Patch Wizard request_set_id
- Adds tool tip to Arrow when expanding collapsing result data
- Updates Java requirement to ensure the analyzers still work on EBS servers with Java 1.7
- Fixed g_banner_message and g_banner_severity framework global variable handling nulls, which prevented these global variables to be populated in newer releases of EBS

Introducing the NEW XML Gateway Analyzer for EBS Release 12.1 and 12.2.

The XML Gateway Analyzer is a self-service health-check script that reviews Oracle XML Gateway related data, analyzes current configurations and settings for the environment, validates the OXTA servlet status, and provides document specific information on outbound documents when requested, and provides feedback and recommendations on best practices.
